Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Good Purpose Investments Inc. (CSE: GPIN) (OTCQB: GPINF) (FSE: 8BS) ("GPI" or the "Company") announces that it has filed its interim financial statements and related management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A") for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Financial and Operating Highlights

All financial figures are stated in Canadian dollars unless otherwise noted.

  • Revenue: $11.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 79% from $6.6 million for the same period in 2025. $3.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 41% from $2.3 million for the same period in 2025.
  • Bags category revenue: $6.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 333% from $1.6 million for the same period in 2025. $2.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 103% from $1.0 million for the same period in 2025.
  • Gross profit: $2.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 90% from $1.3 million for the same period in 2025. $0.65 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up approximately 94% from $0.33 million for the same period in 2025.

"The third quarter of 2026 reflects continued progress in the execution of our growth strategy," said George Tsogas, Chief Executive Officer of GPI. "The performance of Waste2Wear's reusable shopping bags business, alongside improvements in gross profit and gross margins, demonstrates the commercial potential of our existing portfolio. As we look ahead to 2027, our focus remains on scaling our businesses, advancing new commercial opportunities and leveraging the expertise within our platform to deliver long-term shareholder value."

GPI is a platform for the next generation of sustainable businesses. The Company acquires, builds and scales businesses advancing sustainable solutions across products, technologies and brands. Through shared operational expertise, strategic capital, commercial relationships and innovation capabilities, GPI seeks to accelerate the growth of its portfolio companies and create long-term shareholder value.

Brisbane, Australia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Graphene Manufacturing Group Ltd. (TSXV: GMG) (OTCQX: GMGMF) ("GMG" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director Craig Nicol will participate in a live fireside chat hosted by Cory Fleck of the KE Report. The event will take place on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. PT (Vancouver) / 7:00 p.m. ET / Wednesday, December 2, at 10:00 a.m. AEST (Brisbane).

Craig Nicol will discuss the latest G®CELLS fast-charging results, first sample shipments to potential customers and plans to manufacture larger-format cells in the UK. He will also cover new exclusive distribution agreements with Brenntag Química S.A.U., initially covering Spain, Italy and Portugal, and with GrafnoMex in Mexico for G® LUBRICANT. The discussion will also include an update on quality progress at GMG's Gen 2.0 graphene plant. Attendees can submit questions throughout the live discussion.

Register for the live event: https://event.webinarjam.com/gykm4/register/xp0x6fmr

Topics expected to be discussed include:

  • Fast-charging battery results (October 8): Testing at the Battery Innovation Center of Indiana showed an energy density of 58 Wh/kg with six-minute charging, up 48% from 39 Wh/kg. GMG also reported 94% energy efficiency and, in a separate cycling test, no measurable performance loss after 1,000 cycles.
  • First G®CELLS customer samples (October 21): GMG began shipping 1.5 Ah pouch cells designed for six-minute charging to potential customers for evaluation, including in the defence and heavy mobile equipment sectors.
  • European distribution agreement (November 4): GMG signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Brenntag Química S.A.U. covering Spain, Italy and Portugal initially. Brenntag will focus first on G® LUBRICANT through its existing lubricant distribution network while developing opportunities for G® FLUID and THERMAL-XR®.
  • G® LUBRICANT distribution in Mexico (November 12): GMG named GrafnoMex its exclusive distributor in Mexico for G® LUBRICANT, a graphene engine oil additive. GrafnoMex reported lower fuel consumption and emissions in local tests on heavy-duty diesel trucks.
  • UK battery manufacturing (November 19): GMG signed an initial service agreement with the UK Battery Industrialisation Centre to manufacture larger-format G®CELLS in Coventry using battery materials produced at GMG's development centre in Brisbane.
  • Gen 2.0 graphene plant quality progress (November 25): GMG made crucial quality progress at the new, higher production rate of its Gen 2.0 graphene manufacturing plant, which is expected to produce 10 tonnes of graphene per annum once fully completed and optimised.

About GMG

GMG is an Australian based clean-technology company which develops, makes and sells energy saving and energy storage solutions, enabled by graphene manufactured via in house production process. GMG uses its own proprietary production process to decompose natural gas (i.e. methane) into its natural elements, carbon (as graphene), hydrogen and some residual hydrocarbon gases. This process produces high quality, low cost, scalable, 'tuneable' and low/no contaminant graphene suitable for use in clean-technology and other applications.

The Company's present focus is to de-risk and develop commercial scale-up capabilities, and secure market applications. In the energy savings segment, GMG has initially focused on graphene enhanced heating, ventilation and air conditioning ("HVAC-R") coating (or energy-saving coating) which is now being marketed into other applications including electronic heat sinks, industrial process plants and data centres. Another product GMG has developed is the graphene lubricant additive focused on saving liquid fuels initially for diesel engines.

In the energy storage segment, GMG and the University of Queensland are working collaboratively with financial support from the Australian Government to progress R&D and commercialisation of GMG Graphene Batteries. GMG has also developed a graphene additive slurry that is aimed at improving the performance of lithium-ion batteries.

GMG's 4 critical business objectives are:

  • Produce Graphene and improve/scale cell production processes
  • Build Revenue from Energy Savings Products
  • Develop Next-Generation Battery
  • Develop Supply Chain, Partners & Project Execution Capability

Tirzepatide and GLP3 become the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach production, 100% tested and manufactured in the United States by a single manufacturer producing exclusively for the Company; full lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027

Highlights

  • 20,000 tirzepatide and 20,000 GLP3 patches ordered after both passed formal U.S. testing, the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order
  • The Recovery Patch (BPC-157) is on sale now; 20,000 Thymosin Alpha-1 patches ordered for January 2027 delivery; tirzepatide and GLP3 ordered today; full needle-free lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027
  • Both are GLP-1 category patches, aimed at a global GLP-1 market valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033[2,3]
  • 100% tested and manufactured in the United States, by one U.S. manufacturer, with every patch produced solely for the Company under exclusive manufacturing rights
  • No needle, no mixing, no measuring, no refrigeration

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. They are the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1, and the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the first quarter of 2027, up from the single patch on sale today.

The tirzepatide patch was announced as under development on August 19, 2026 and entered formal U.S. testing on October 13, 2026. The GLP3 patch entered development on October 20, 2026. Both are in the Company's metabolic and weight-management category, and both have now passed the same U.S. testing stage that the Company's BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1 ("TA1") patches passed before their own production orders.

100% Tested and Manufactured in the United States

Every patch in the line follows the same production and testing process: formulated in the United States, tested in the United States by an independent laboratory, produced in the United States, then released. The first patch through that process, The Recovery Patch (BPC-157), recorded 95.5% chromatographic purity and a quantified 2.02 mg dose per patch in independent laboratory testing, exceeding the 95% threshold widely used as the benchmark for high-purity peptide products.

TA1 followed with a 20,000-unit order at 2 mg per patch. Tirzepatide and GLP3 have now cleared the same stage. All four formulations are produced by one U.S. manufacturer solely for the Company under the exclusive manufacturing rights announced on October 22, 2026, so that one testing standard and one production standard apply across the whole line.

The Needle-Free Line at a Glance

ProductStageLatest milestone
BPC-157 (The Recovery Patch)On saleIndependent U.S. laboratory testing recorded 95.5% purity and a 2.02 mg dose per patch (May 19, 2026); approximately 20,000 units received July 2026 (July 14, 2026); available at store.precisionpep.co
Thymosin Alpha-1 (TA1)In productionEntered formal U.S. testing September 2026; 20,000 units ordered October 2026 at 2 mg per patch, delivery expected January 2027 (October 7, 2026)
TirzepatideIn productionDevelopment announced August 2026 (August 19, 2026); entered formal U.S. testing October 2026 (October 13, 2026); testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
GLP3In productionDevelopment announced October 2026 (October 20, 2026); formal U.S. testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
MOTS-cIn developmentDevelopment announced November 26, 2026

 

A Full Line by Q1 2027

The Recovery Patch, on sale since July 2026, was the first product in the Company's needle-free range. With 20,000-unit orders now placed for TA1, tirzepatide and GLP3, the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the end of the first quarter of 2027. Each patch will be sold through the Company's direct-to-consumer website and its wholesale program for clinics, medical spas, gyms and retailers in all 50 U.S. states.

No Needle, No Mixing, No Refrigeration

Injectable peptides, including the Company's own prescription vials, are typically supplied as a powder that must be mixed with sterile water, measured into a syringe, injected and kept refrigerated. The Company's patches remove those steps. The Company's patches are applied to the skin, and each patch delivers a pre-measured dose: no needle, no mixing, no measuring, no cold storage. Discreet, portable and consistent from one dose to the next, they fit into a daily routine and open peptides to the many people who were interested but prefer not to use a syringe.

Market Context

Tirzepatide and GLP3 are the Company's two patches in the metabolic and weight-management category. The global GLP-1 market was valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033,[2,3] with injectable delivery accounting for 69.1% of the market in 2025.[2] The broader global peptide therapeutics market was valued at US$56.06 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach US$87.21 billion by 2035, with North America the largest regional market.[1] The Company believes that U.S.-based development, testing and manufacturing, combined with a needle-free format, position it to compete as those markets expand.

The foregoing market data is provided as context for the Company's product development activities and should not be construed as a projection of the Company's future revenue or market share.

Pratap Sandhu, CEO of The Precision Peptide Company, commented:

"We are making significant progress in turning our needle-free patches into a commercial product portfolio. In just four months, we have grown from one patch on sale to three additional patches ordered for production, including 40,000 tirzepatide and GLP3 patches following successful U.S. testing. Our exclusive U.S. manufacturing partnership gives us a strong foundation to expand production while maintaining consistent quality standards. We are targeting commercial availability of all four patches by March 2027, with MOTS-c now also in development as our fifth. Our priority is clear: accelerate commercialization, expand our product portfolio and establish The Precision Peptide Company as a leader in needle-free peptide delivery."

St. Lewis, Newfoundland and Labrador--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Search Minerals Inc. (TSXV: SMY) (OTC Pink: SHCMF) ("Search Minerals" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a binding term sheet (the "Term Sheet") with certain lenders (the "Lenders"), including two of the Company's largest shareholders, Petra Holdings Company Inc. ("Petra") and Harder Investments Ltd. ("Harder"), for the Lenders to provide the Company a C$1.4 million secured convertible loan (the "Loan"). The proceeds from the Loan will be primarily used to repay the Company's C$700,000 principal amount convertible note issued to Texas Critical Minerals, LLC ("TCM") in October 2024, which matured on October 25, 2025, together with all accrued interest.

The principal amount of the Loan will mature and be repayable in full on the date which is three years from closing, and will be convertible into common shares at the option of the Lenders at any time prior to the close of business on the maturity date at a conversion price of $0.30 per share. The principal amount of the Loan will bear interest at 8.5% per annum, payable annually on December 31, commencing December 31, 2027. Subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), Search will have the option to pay interest in common shares in lieu of cash at the market price for the common shares at the time the interest becomes payable. Any conversion that would result in a Lender becoming a Control Person (as defined in the policies of the TSXV) will be subject to prior TSXV approval, including shareholder approval. The Loan will be secured by a pledge of the shares of the Company's subsidiaries Alterra Resources Inc. and 86857 Newfoundland & Labrador Inc., together with guarantees and personal property security granted by those subsidiaries.

Upon completion, the transaction is expected to:

  • Lower interest rate costs: reduce the interest rate on the TCM note being repaid from 15% to 8.5%;
  • Reduce TCM's claims: resolve the claim TCM has filed against the Company relating to the note, one of three claims filed by TCM against the Company as disclosed in the Company's financial statements. With respect to the two remaining claims, the Company continues to dispute the amounts alleged to be owing, believes it has credible defences, and intends to defend its position while remaining focused on advancing its core projects and protecting shareholder interests; and
  • Improve working capital: remove past-due debt owed to TCM from the Company's working capital deficit, subject to final accounting treatment, by extending the maturity dates for the Company's debt and treating such liability as non-current, and provide funds for general working capital.

Jonathan Beigle, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Search Minerals, commented: "We appreciate the continued support of our largest shareholders. This financing allows us to repay the TCM note, lower our interest costs and extend maturities. This will allow us to focus all of our effort on advancing our projects for the benefit of all shareholders."

Closing of the transaction is expected in mid-December, 2026. The Term Sheet is a preliminary binding agreement; completion of the transaction remains subject to, among other things, negotiation and execution of definitive documentation, approval of the Company's Board of Directors and a special committee of independent directors, acceptance of the TSXV, and satisfaction of customary conditions. There can be no assurance that the transaction will be completed on the terms described or at all.

The Loan, and any common shares issued on conversion of the Loan, will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance of the Loan, in accordance with applicable securities legislation and TSXV policies. Any common shares issued in payment of interest will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from their date of issuance.

Petra is controlled by Michael Pearson, a director of the Company, and Petra also owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Petra is a "related party" of the Company. Harder owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Harder is also a "related party" of the Company. As a result, the transaction is a related party transaction subject to Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The transaction is exempt from the formal valuation requirements of MI 61-101 pursuant to subsection 5.5(b) of MI 61-101 because the Company's common Shares are listed only on the TSXV and is exempt from the minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 pursuant to subsection 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 because neither the fair market value of the subject matter of, nor the fair market value of the consideration for, the transaction, insofar as it involves interested parties, exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization as determined in accordance with MI 61-101.

ABOUT SEARCH MINERALS

Led by a proven management team and board of directors, Search is focused on finding and developing Critical Rare Earth Elements (CREE), Zirconium (Zr) and Hafnium (Hf) resources within the emerging Port Hope Simpson - St. Lewis CREE District of southeast Labrador. The Company controls a belt 64 km long and 2 km wide that is road accessible, on tidewater, and located near three local communities. The Company has completed a preliminary economic assessment report with resource estimates for Foxtrot and Deep Fox. It is also working on four exploration prospects along the belt: Fox Meadow, Silver Fox, Fox Run and Awesome Fox.

The Company has completed two pilot plant operations and produced highly purified mixed rare earth carbonate concentrate and mixed REO concentrate for separation and refining.

By making recycled materials identifiable and certifiable, SMX aims to help manufacturers, recyclers and regulators move beyond traditional reporting methods toward a system grounded in scientific proof.

The Denver Post placement comes as the national conversation around recycling increasingly shifts from environmental commitments to measurable outcomes, regulatory compliance and the economic competitiveness of recycled materials.

SMX's technology is designed to help bridge the gap between legislative ambition and industrial execution, providing the tools necessary to build a more transparent, accountable and commercially viable circular economy.

Provides Drilling Update on its Flagship Elida Porphyry Cu-Mo-Ag Deposit

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Element 29 Resources Inc. (TSXV: ECU) (OTCQX: EMTRF) (BVL: ECU) ("Element 29" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has signed a three-year surface Access Agreement with the host community at its Flor de Cobre Porphyry Copper-Molybdenum ("Cu-Mo") Project ("Flor de Cobre" or the "Project") in southern Perú (Figure 1). This agreement, which expires November 5, 2029, secures long-term access to Flor de Cobre and marks a significant milestone for the Company.

Richard Osmond, President and CEO, commented: "The successful signing of the community Access Agreement underscores the strength of our local relationships and commitment to advancing our projects in close collaboration with rightsholders. We remain focused on progressing Flor de Cobre in a responsible and mutually beneficial manner as we work to unlock its full exploration potential. We are grateful to the community for their ongoing support and partnership."

The signing of the Access Agreement with the host Indigenous community at Flor de Cobre satisfies the final outstanding community-access requirement associated with the Company's application for a Permiso de Inicio de Actividades ("PIA") drilling permit. The PIA application seeks authorization to commence exploration drilling covered by the already approved Declaración de Impacto Ambiental ("DIA") environmental certificate, which provides for drilling from up to 40 platforms over a five-year period (see the March 1, 2024 news release).

The Company previously received an exemption from the Consulta Previa ("Prior Consultation") process on October 21, 2024 (see October 31, 2024 news release), following a review by the Peruvian Ministry of Energy and Mines ("MINEM") of the Collective Impacts Report and its assessment of the potential impacts of exploration drilling on the host Indigenous community's lands.

The Company submitted the PIA application to MINEM on November 10, 2026, which remains pending review and final approval.

Elida Drilling Program Update

The ongoing Elida drilling program is being conducted under the 40-platform PIA drill permit approved in July of 2026 (see the July 28, 2026, news release). The Company started the year with two diamond drill rigs, then added a third rig in September and a fourth is scheduled to arrive in early December. The Company has completed 9,292 metres of its planned 10,000-metre 2026 program. Cumulative drilling at Elida now totals 32,699 metres, more than twice the 14,361 metres of drilling used to prepare the 2022 initial pit-constrained Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") ¹.

Elida is accessible year-round for drilling, and the Company plans to continue the program with four rigs for the remainder of 2026 and through 2027. Local assay laboratory turnaround is currently two to four weeks.

Assay Results Pending for Recently Completed Holes

Recently completed holes ELID044 and ELID045 reached depths of 1,812.8 metres and 1,820.6 metres, respectively. Both holes focused on step-out drilling to extend Zone 1 westward and evaluate potential resource expansion beyond the current MRE. They were designed to follow up on the long-mineralized intercepts in ELID033, ELID035 and ELID037, which suggest the potential for stronger Cu-Mo-Ag mineralization at depth and westward toward the contact with the Coastal Batholith (Figure 2).

ELID044 intersected 1,572.9 metres of potassic-altered volcanosedimentary rocks, from 35.1 metres below the bedrock surface to 1,608.0 metres downhole. The interval contains porphyry-related stockwork veining of varying intensity, with disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. At 1,608.0 metres, the hole entered a potassic-altered granodiorite intrusion with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. The granodiorite continued to the end of the hole at 1,812.8 metres, where drilling was shut down due to the depth limitations of the rig.

ELID045 intersected potassic-altered volcanosedimentary rocks, from 78.7 metres below the bedrock surface to 1,245.5 metres downhole. The interval contains stockwork veining, with disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. At 1,245.5 metres, the hole intersected 61.2 metres of potassic-altered granodiorite cut by narrow fingers of potassic-altered quartz monzonite porphyry ("QMP"). Both rock types contain stockwork veining with disseminated chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. From 1,306.7 metres, the hole intersected 358.9 metres of potassic-altered QMP, interpreted as an early-intermineral porphyry, with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. Below this interval, the hole re-entered potassic-altered, locally brecciated volcanosedimentary rocks, with stockwork veining and disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. The hole terminated at 1,820.6 metres due to the depth limitations of the rig.

ELID046 was drilled to a depth of 956.2 metres and was the first hole to evaluate Zone 4, a high-priority target immediately west of Zone 1 within the Elida porphyry cluster. Zone 4 hosts a mineralized porphyry stock emplaced along the contact between the Coastal Batholith and volcanosedimentary rocks. The stock and host rocks exhibit phyllic alteration overprinting earlier potassic alteration, as well as visible copper-oxide staining and anomalous Cu-Mo rock geochemistry. These features support the target's prospectivity for Cu-Mo-Ag mineralization. The hole intersected a 395.9-metre interval of phyllic-overprinted, potassic-altered QMP beginning at 197.8 metres downhole. The QMP is interpreted as a potassic-altered intermineral porphyry intrusion, with stockwork veining containing disseminated and stringer chalcopyrite-molybdenite mineralization. Locally, chalcocite and covellite occur as disseminations and rimming chalcopyrite and pyrite.

True widths are unknown, and assay results for all three holes are pending.

Metallurgical Test Work

In parallel, the Company is advancing the resource modelling and metallurgical test work with Synectiq Inc., as announced on May 7, 2026. The test work is designed to characterize the principal ore types, evaluate copper, molybdenum, and silver recoveries, and assess concentrate quality. The results are intended to support assumptions for an updated mineral resource estimate and future technical studies.

About Flor de Cobre

Flor de Cobre is located 35 kilometres southeast of Arequipa and straddles the border between the Departments of Arequipa and Moquegua, the Provinces of Arequipa and General Sanchez Cerro, and the Districts of Polobaya and La Capilla.

The property is comprised of eleven mining concessions for a total of 2,984.4 hectares ("ha") which are 100% owned by the Company's Peruvian subsidiary Candelaria Resources S.A.C. The project is in the Southern Perú Copper Belt, which is host to numerous porphyry Cu-Mo deposits, including the Cerro Verde Cu-Mo mine operated by Freeport-McMoRan2; the Cuajone and Toquepala Cu-Mo mines operated by Southern Copper2; and the Quellaveco Cu-Mo mine operated by Anglo American2. Flor de Cobre is 5 kilometres northwest of the Chapi Mine and 26 kilometres southeast of the Cerro Verde Mine (Figure 1).

Flor de Cobre hosts the Atravesado porphyry Cu-Mo target, a classic Andean porphyry system with Cu-Mo mineralization potentially associated with a multi-phase quartz monzonite porphyry complex. Atravesado is characterized by widespread Cu-oxide mineralization and strong surface rock Cu geochemistry associated with lower Cretaceous-aged quartzite and sandstone sedimentary rocks which form the upper part of the Yura Group. These rocks are also cut by several narrow potassic altered quartz monzonite porphyry dykes.

The property is situated at a modest elevation of 2,700 metres with excellent infrastructure for future mine development and is accessible along paved and maintained unpaved roads from the hub-city of Arequipa.

NESS ZIONA, Israel, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq and TASE: FRSX) (“Foresight” or the “Company”), an innovator in 3D perception systems and AI autonomous stacks, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Foresight Intelligent Systems Ltd., has received a conditional and non-binding order from an Indian drone manufacturing company for thermal ScaleCam 3D perception systems. The order is valued at approximately $1.3 million and the systems are intended for integration into autonomous drones for the Indian defense forces.

The order is part of the commercial cooperation framework announced by the Company in January 2025 with a prominent Indian drone manufacturer that is a supplier of the Indian Ministry of Defense. That framework carried previously disclosed commercial potential of up to $2.1 million. The current order follows the successful completion of the validation of Foresight’s thermal ScaleCam 3D perception solution under the agreement.

The order is conditional and remains subject to certain conditions including the successful completion of trials with the Indian Navy, completion of the relevant procurement and commercial negotiation process, and receipt of all required governmental, export-control, and regulatory approvals, where applicable.

Foresight’s 3D perception solution, which uses stereoscopic long-wave infrared technology and integrates internal measurement unit sensors, is designed to maintain robust autonomous drone performances in challenging GPS-denied environments such as dense smoke, poor lighting and high temperatures, enabling the detection of fire source and all object detection while providing real-time information on the drone’s spatial positioning. These capabilities make the solution particularly well-suited for defense unmanned ariel vehicle applications.

“The receipt of this conditional order is an important step forward in our collaboration with our Indian partner and validates the successful completion of the development phase,” said Haim Siboni, Chief Executive Officer of Foresight Intelligent Systems Ltd. “We look forward to progressing through the remaining trials and procurement stages.”

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / EON Resources Inc. (NYSE American:EONR) ("EON" or the "Company") is an independent upstream energy company with 20,000 leasehold acres in the Permian Basin with approximately 1.2 billion barrels of original oil in place. Today, the Company announced that it reported a theft of property from the oil field to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force (the "NMOTTF") that led to arrests of several suspects.

On Saturday, November 21, 2026, at approximately 3:00 am, three suspects wearing dark masks, in a blue pickup, were caught on security cameras at the Grayburg-Jackson oil field in Eddy County, New Mexico owned and operated by LH Operating, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of EON. The suspects cut and stole copper wire critical to some of the field's operations.

"Each of the perpetrators were wearing masks, but the Company had good surveillance video including video of the pickup truck involved. All video and photographs were turned over to the SE New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force," said Dante Caravaggio, CEO of EON. EON also posted the same photographs on social media hoping someone would recognize and help identify the pickup and individuals. A Good Samaritan reported individuals and a vehicle matching the description from the surveillance footage. With the volunteered information turned over to the NMOTTF, the NMOTTF arrived at a residence where a truck was located fitting the description of the truck used in the theft and arrests were made.

According to authorities, a significant amount of copper wire was identified at the residence. The copper wire had been stripped of its insulation.

The NMOTTF moved quickly to identify alleged participants within two days of the theft. Limited production in the field was partially interrupted for 3 days until new wire could be procured and installed on a fast-track basis.

"We are thrilled to have reported the theft directly to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force who were incredible. We hope cameras and quick action, as was the case this time, help all operators bring down costs, downtime, and losses from criminal activity that hurts everyone," stated Dante Caravaggio.

TAICHUNG, Taiwan, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd (NASDAQ: AGCC) ("Agencia" or the "Company") today provided an update on its AI computing and data center business and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance with the applicable laws and regulations governing its business. The Company also clarified certain matters referred to in a media report published on November 25, 2026 (the "Report"). The Report does not allege that the Company has breached any law or regulation.

Expanding From Whisky Into AI Computing Infrastructure and Data Center Operations

Agencia listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market in October 2025 as an importer and distributor of whisky, a business that it continues to operate. In reviewing opportunities for growth beyond whisky, the Board of Directors identified strong demand for AI computing capacity and data centers in Southeast Asia, a region in which the Company and its management have established business relationships. Southeast Asia has attracted substantial data center investment from international operators, supported by the availability of land and power at competitive cost. The Company believes that this market offers long-term growth opportunities.

To develop that opportunity, the Board appointed Mr. Li Qiang as Chairman on December 11, 2025. Mr. Li has more than 20 years of experience in the data center and technology infrastructure industry, and he oversees the development of the Company's data center business.

Since announcing its AI computing strategy in February 2026, Agencia has been developing its data center and AI computing business and, directly or through its subsidiaries, has entered into a number of agreements for that purpose, as disclosed in its reports filed with or furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Company expects to begin providing AI computing services once the computing capacity it has contracted from its provider is in place, subject to and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Like other companies listed in the United States, Agencia aims to build long-term value for its shareholders, and it will continue to evaluate opportunities that can do so within applicable laws and regulations.

Commitment to Compliance

Agencia is committed to conducting its business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the export control laws and regulations of the United States. The Company has not sold or supplied any product or service to any party in breach of the export control laws of the United States or of any other jurisdiction, and it has no intention of doing so.

Under the Company's computing capacity agreement, the provider warrants that the equipment used to provide the services is sourced through authorized sales channels and is exported and imported in compliance with applicable export control laws.

On November 19, 2026, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Department of Commerce ("BIS") published an interim final rule on remote access to advanced semiconductors. The rule introduces new requirements that may apply to the Company's computing capacity and customer arrangements. Those requirements, and the steps that manufacturers and suppliers are taking in response to them, may affect those arrangements, including their timing. The Company is reviewing the rule, and its supplier and customer arrangements, with its advisers. It is committed to complying with all applicable rules and regulations and will provide services only as they permit.

Clarification Regarding Recent Media Report

The Company wishes to clarify two matters referred to in the Report.

The Company's business. The Company is not a seller or reseller of semiconductor chips or hardware. Agencia's data center business is a services business comprising two service lines: data center colocation services, which will provide space, power and connectivity for customers’ own equipment, and AI computing services, in which the Company contracts for computing capacity to provide AI computing cloud services to its customers. No AI semiconductors, hardware or servers are, or are planned to be, sold, delivered or transferred to any customer in either service line.

Relevant entities highlighted in the Report. The Report describes Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings Limited ("Yuxing InfoTech") as the parent company of Ricloud AI Inc. ("Ricloud AI"). The document that the Report cites for that statement, the 2025 annual report of Yuxing InfoTech, lists Ricloud Corp. as a subsidiary of Yuxing InfoTech. It does not list Ricloud AI as a subsidiary. Ricloud Corp. and Ricloud AI are separate legal entities.

The Company's related party relationships and transactions are disclosed in its filings with the SEC, including its prospectus filed on July 20, 2026. Mr. Li's positions with Yuxing InfoTech and with Ricloud AI are described in that prospectus.

"Agencia began as a small whisky business, and we are building a second business in data center and AI computing infrastructure because we see a real opportunity to create value for our shareholders," said Mr. LIU Shihao, Chief Financial Officer of Agencia. "Our focus is on disciplined execution and on building this business transparently and in compliance with the laws of the United States and of every country in which we operate."

Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed company with two principal business focuses: (i) its established premium whisky operations; and (ii) the development of data center and AI computing infrastructure, including data center colocation services and cloud-based AI computing services.

Since early 2026, the Company has launched and been developing its AI Computing Infrastructure Initiative, covering data center colocation and AI cloud computing services through subsidiaries in Singapore, Indonesia and other jurisdictions. This initiative represents a principal business focus, backed by substantive contractual arrangements for commercial AI computing cloud services and the development of supporting data center, power, network and technical infrastructure. The Company’s historical operating revenue has been derived from its whisky operations, and the data center and AI computing business remain in development and deployment and is subject to significant business, financing, construction, technology, regulatory, customer demand and execution risks.

TOKYO, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aurora Mobile Limited (NASDAQ: JG) ("Aurora Mobile" or the "Company"), a leading provider of customer engagement and marketing technology services, opened its "AI in Action: Bringing AI to Enterprise" global roadshow in Tokyo on November 24, hosting a closed-door summit for enterprise technology leaders from across Japan. The event marked the first stop of the Company's 2026 international series.


The adoption paradox
AI agents can now handle complex, cross-system tasks that were out of reach a year ago. Yet capability has not translated into business outcomes. In his opening keynote, Mr. Weidong Luo, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Aurora Mobile, described what he called the "AI adoption paradox": 44% of enterprises are expanding their AI deployments, but only 6% report meaningful business returns, while more than 40% of agent projects stall, regress or are cancelled.

The obstacle, he argued, is not model intelligence but the absence of infrastructure that lets AI act safely. He put the question to the room directly: if AI could complete half a day of work on its own, would you give it write access to your CRM or ERP?

Moving from fixed workflows to autonomous agents, Mr. Luo said, depends less on how capable the model is than on how prepared the enterprise is: "Your agents are only as ready as your enterprise."

He set out three principles for enterprise AI readiness:

  • Make systems callable — connect business systems through APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so agents can read and act, not merely converse;
  • Make know-how reusable — turn proven business methods into shared, callable "skills" the whole team can use;
  • Govern every action — layer approval workflows and audit logs over every tool and skill an agent can reach.


GWork: GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace
At the summit, Aurora Mobile introduced GWork, GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace. Designed to bring AI into employees’ everyday work, GWork connects to the tools and company systems they already use, helping them conduct research, analyze data, and create reports, documents, and presentations. IT teams can centrally manage access, usage, and security.

Deployments in the field
The program also featured customers describing how AI is being applied in their own operations, across real estate, contact center services and systems integration:

  • KINAKO LLC — Real estate: rethinking how buyers are matched. The operator of the MANGIRO real estate platform described applying AI to multilingual customer communication and property proposals.

Upgrading to the OTCQX Market is an important step for companies seeking to provide transparent trading for their U.S. investors. For companies listed on a qualified international exchange, streamlined market standards enable them to utilize their home market reporting to make their information available in the U.S. To qualify for OTCQX, companies must meet high financial standards, follow best practice corporate governance and demonstrate compliance with applicable securities laws.

Together with the commercialisation of Redox One, we are building a diversified business positioned to create value through the cycle, and we look forward to engaging with a broader base of U.S. investors.”

Trading in European securities on OTC Markets reached $97.45 billion in the third quarter of 2026, representing an 23.37% increase over Q3 2025. About Tharisa – funded growth, a second mining asset in development, commercialising technology

Tharisa plc is an integrated resource group producing platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates, commodities central to the global energy transition and the decarbonisation of industry. The Group operates across the full value chain – exploration, mining, processing, beneficiation, marketing, sales, and logistics.

The Tharisa Mine, on the south-western limb of the Bushveld Complex in South Africa, is a multi-generational operation co-producing PGMs and chrome from a single orebody – a combination that underpins the Group’s cost position through the commodity cycle. Downstream beneficiation, including the Vulcan ultra-fine chrome recovery plant and proven chrome and PGM alloy production, extends the Group’s reach along the value chain.

The Karo Platinum Project on Zimbabwe’s Great Dyke is the Group’s second major mining asset and is under development. Phase 1 is designed to produce approximately 226 koz of PGMs a year at steady state, more than doubling Group PGM production, with first ore to the mill expected in the fourth quarter of calendar 2027. A binding term sheet for the offtake of Karo’s PGM concentrate has been signed with Valterra Platinum for an initial five-year term.

Through Redox One, Tharisa is commercialising proprietary iron-chromium redox flow battery technology for long-duration energy storage, using the chrome and iron the Group already produces.

Tharisa targets a 30% reduction in carbon emissions by 2030 and net carbon neutrality by 2050.
